name: Light of Life Trust
description: Light of Life Trust is a non-governmental organization established in 2002 and registered under the Bombay Public Trust Act, 1950 founded by Villy Doctor, with a vision to transform the lives of underprivileged rural communities. Light of Life Trust believes that roots must be strengthened and nurtured to grow healthy plants, so, we strengthen our roots, the rural people of India, and nourish them through our two verticals: Project Anando (Education) & Project Jagruti (Community Development).

owner_posts.post_text:
Creating Positive Change Through Education & Community Development 

At Light of Life Trust, we are dedicated to supporting education, women empowerment, healthcare, and sustainable community development initiatives across India. Our mission is to help individuals and communities build a brighter future through meaningful programs and opportunities.

Whether you're looking to support an NGO in Mumbai, volunteer, or contribute to educational initiatives, every small effort can make a difference.

💙 Support Education Programs
💙 Empower Communities
💙 Volunteer for a Cause
💙 Join Us in Creating Lasting Impact

📞 Connect with us today to learn how you can contribute and be a part of positive change.

Medical Mobile Unit – Bringing Healthcare to Your Community

At Light of Life Trust, our Medical Mobile Unit brings essential healthcare services directly to communities in need. We understand that access to quality medical care isn’t always easy, especially for underserved populations. That’s why our mobile unit travels to neighbourhoods, villages, and outreach areas to provide compassionate, reliable health services where they’re needed most.

If you’re looking for reliable, compassionate Medical Mobile Unit services for your community or organization, Light of Life Trust is here to help. Together, we can make healthcare more accessible and equitable for all.

Learn more about our Mobile Healthcare Services.

Anando School Empowerment Programme

The Anando School Empowerment Programme by Light of Life Trust is dedicated to uplifting and empowering students across communities. Our programme focuses on holistic development, providing children with access to quality education, life skills, and mentorship opportunities that foster confidence, creativity, and personal growth.

Through interactive workshops, skill-building activities, and continuous guidance, we help students realise their full potential and prepare them for a brighter future. 

Learn more about the Anando School Empowerment Programme and support the growth and empowerment of young minds today!

Environment Conservation Programme for a Greener Tomorrow

The Environment Conservation Programme by Light of Life Trust is dedicated to creating a greener, more sustainable future through community-driven initiatives. By focusing on environmental awareness, tree plantation, and sustainable practices, the program empowers individuals and communities to take meaningful steps toward protecting natural resources.

Through education and active participation, the initiative encourages responsible habits that contribute to long-term ecological balance. From rural outreach to hands-on activities, every effort is designed to make a lasting impact on both people and the environment.

Be a part of positive change. Join the Environment Conservation Programme today and help build a cleaner, healthier future for generations to come.

Donate Today – Support Education & Empower Lives with Light of Life Trust

Looking to donate and make a real difference? Light of Life Trust helps transform the lives of underprivileged children and communities across India through education, career guidance, and skill development. Your contribution directly supports programs that empower young girls and students to break the cycle of poverty and build brighter futures. Whether you give once or choose ongoing support, every donation helps create lasting change. Join us in making education accessible and meaningful—donate today and be part of a powerful journey of hope and opportunity.

Your support can help a child access education and a brighter future. Make your donation today!

Best NGO in Mumbai Supporting Communities with Care

As the best NGO in Mumbai, we are dedicated to creating meaningful change by supporting communities in need through education, healthcare, and social welfare initiatives. Our mission is to uplift underprivileged individuals and provide opportunities that help them build a better future. With a compassionate approach and strong community involvement, we work tirelessly to make a positive impact.

Recognised as a best NGO in Mumbai, our organisation focuses on empowering people, spreading awareness, and encouraging social responsibility. Through various programmes and volunteer support, we strive to bring hope, dignity, and long-term improvement to the lives of those who need it the most.

Anando Plus Programme | Light of Life Trust

The Anando Plus Programme by Light of Life Trust is a meaningful initiative designed to support the education and overall development of underprivileged children in India. Through this program, students receive guidance, learning resources, and mentorship that help them stay in school and build a brighter future. The Anando Plus Programme focuses not only on academic growth but also on life skills, confidence building, and personal development. With the support of dedicated mentors and community partners, the program empowers children to overcome challenges and pursue their dreams with hope and determination.

Building a Greener Tomorrow with Our Environment Conservation Programme

The Environment Conservation Programme by Light of Life Trust is dedicated to promoting sustainable living and environmental awareness. Through community engagement, educational workshops, and green initiatives, we encourage individuals to understand the importance of protecting natural resources. Our goal is to inspire responsible habits that support a cleaner and healthier environment for future generations. By working with students, communities, and volunteers, we continue to create meaningful environmental impact and awareness.

Join our Environment Conservation Programme and be part of the change today!

Best NGO in Mumbai | Supporting Education & Community Welfare

Light of Life Trust is recognised as one of the best NGO in Mumbai, dedicated to empowering underprivileged communities through education, skill development, and sustainable livelihood programmes. Our mission is to create opportunities for children and youth from disadvantaged backgrounds so they can build a brighter and more independent future.

Through various initiatives, we support education, mentorship, and career guidance for students who need it the most. Our dedicated team and volunteers work closely with communities to bring long-term positive change and promote social development.

Learn more today!

Build Skills for a Better Future with Our Livelihood Training Programme

Empower your future with the Livelihood Training Programme at Light of Life Trust. Our programme is designed to help individuals build practical skills, boost confidence, and create real opportunities for sustainable employment and self-reliance. Whether you’re learning vocational skills, mastering digital tools, or gaining hands-on experience, our supportive trainers are with you every step of the way. We focus on real-world learning, personal growth, and strong community support so every participant can unlock their potential. Join us and take the next step toward a brighter, more independent future.

owner_posts.post_text:
Behind every healthy smile of our child is a doctor’s dedication, care, and kindness. 💙

This International Doctor’s Day, we celebrate the incredible professionals who stand beside our children with patience, expertise, and compassion.

From tiny moments of care to life-changing support, your presence helps our children feel safe, strong, and cared for.

Thank you for being a part of their journey✨

Learning through Role play! 🌟

Our children enjoyed an engaging Role Play Session conducted by Morgann stanely volunteers. Through fun scenarios like patient–doctor, teacher–student, and more, children explored different roles, practiced communication, and learned how to respond in various situations.

A fun-filled activity that encouraged confidence and social skills in children ✨

Our children enjoyed a wonderful and engaging storytelling session✨

Through interactive stories, the children explored important values, enhanced their listening and imagination skills, and actively participated by sharing their thoughts and experiences. Their enthusiasm, curiosity, and involvement made the session truly special.

A heartfelt thank you to   volunteers from Giant Group of Byculla for creating a fun learning experience that inspired our young minds.

Our children had fun creating cute paper puppy puppets with colours, folding, and with their creativity. ✂️✨

Such activities boost creativity and help to build focus and confidence. 🌟

At Bal Asha Trust, we believe every child’s rightful place is in a family. 💛

This belief continues to guide our work in family restoration, reunification, and adoption because children thrive best with love, belonging, and emotional security.

Last year alone, 115 children were connected to families through our efforts, including 101 family restorations and 14 adoptions. ❤️

On the International Day of Families, we reaffirm our commitment to ensuring that every child has the opportunity to grow up with the warmth, care, and support of family life.

We are happy to felicitate our 10 SSC students from our Education sponsorship programme who have passed their Board exams.

Their dedication has made us proud ✨

Where play meets purpose and learning feels like fun. 

Kids learning about vehicles 🚗

Such interactive activities help our children develop skills, curiosity, and a love for learning.

It was an honour for Bal Asha Trust to be chosen to share our experiences with government officials from Tamil Nadu, who visited to gain insights into the functioning of a Specialised Adoption Agency (SAA) and child protection practices followed in Mumbai.

As part of a DWCD training organized by TISS,  The officials undertook field visits to understand on-ground child protection systems in Maharashtra, and we were grateful to be among the organisations they chose to learn from.

Such knowledge-sharing visits strengthen collective efforts toward building safer and more responsive child protection systems for children. 🤝💙

Before support begins, clarity comes first. 💛

At Bal Asha Trust, our social workers engage closely with families even before enrolment into the Education Sponsorship Programme. Through orientation sessions, they help families understand the purpose of the programme, eligibility criteria, and how children will be supported.

This year, we are focusing on deeper engagement with families and scaling our reach, so that more children can benefit from the right support at the right time. 🤝📖

Because when expectations are aligned, support becomes truly meaningful.

A visionary who turned education into a weapon for equality.

On this Ambedkar Jayanti, we honour Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar—the architect of our Constitution and a tireless champion of equality, education, and justice.

His timeless legacy continues to guide generations toward a more inclusive India.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Mhaske
featured_reviews.review_text:
Outstanding guidance and Exemplary support – Highly Recommended

Bal Asha Trust has been absolutely exceptional in supporting throughout the entire adoption process of CARA. From start to finish, their professionalism, compassion, and deep understanding of adoption procedures truly stood out. It is evident why Bal Asha Trust is regarded as one of the best adoption agencies in the country and has received numerous prestigious awards—their work genuinely reflects those honors.

A special note of gratitude to Sunil Sir and Swaroopa Madam, whose in-depth knowledge of the adoption process is remarkable. Their guidance, clarity, and patience at every stage made what could have been an overwhelming journey feel structured, transparent, and reassuring. Their expertise and commitment inspired immense confidence and trust.

I would also like to sincerely appreciate Ms. Ritoja and Mrs. Angel for their excellent support. They were always approachable, responsive, and proactive in providing timely assistance whenever needed. Their coordination and constant follow-ups ensured that every requirement was handled smoothly and without unnecessary stress.

What truly sets Bal Asha Trust apart is their genuine care for both the children and the adoptive parents. Their ethical practices, attention to detail, and humane approach make the entire process respectful and child-centric.

I wholeheartedly recommend Bal Asha Trust to anyone considering adoption. They are a highly reliable, compassionate, and award-worthy organization that sets the benchmark for adoption services in the country.

It was great to be here and witness the genuine, structured work being done by the team.

We truly appreciate what Bal Asha Trust is doing and would encourage others to support them in any way possible, whether through donations, volunteering, or simply spreading the word.

name: Spark-A-Change Foundation
description:
We are an 8-yr old Mumbai-based registered Not-for-Profit entity, providing programs providing educational and vocational opportunities to children and youth from underserved backgrounds through various in-school and after school programs.
We impact over 1500 beneficiaries through our programs :
1. Anviksha Early Education Program – collaborations with MPS schools to support early education in 22 BMC classrooms
2. Anviksha Community Preschool – a free quality preschool for early learners
3. Foundational Learning Program – a volunteer driven program for grades 1-7
4. Board Ready Program – an tutorial program for students of grades 8-12
5. Youth Empowerment Program – a mentoring and support program for college students
